object: complete dock + pulley station, raised/resting pose
lens: Shared three-area-light rig, orthographic lens at gameplay pitch (~43 deg), ortho scale 10.6 identical across all four directions

north.notes: Back faces fully modeled; both rope rails sag between posts onto real post tops; piles and waterline sleeves descend into the water; shore and bank pads meet the thresholds flush.

south.notes: L silhouette unmistakable; plank ends read hand-cut with honest gaps over the bearers; crossed shore braces meet at the mid pile; nothing floats.

east.notes: Bank-span end face reads plank-by-plank; bucket hangs on the taut fall rope beside (never over) the set-down ledge; crank outboard of the crossbeam; proud corner bollards capped.

west.notes: Shore entry open with no rail crossing the lane; stones half-buried at the contact; below-deck bearers, braces, and pile pairs all connect.

defectsFoundAndFixed: The bucket set-down ledge originally sat directly in the drop line and the lowering bucket clipped straight through it; the ledge was rebuilt east of the fall rope beside the crank.
The bucket interior cylinder capped almost flush with the rim and read as a closed lid; rebuilt as a recessed shadowed wall with a visible warm floor a quarter-tile down.
Bucket staves were too gappy (cage read); widened to overlap.
Deck seams at both plank-direction turns showed open gaps; closed with structural junction sills.
